title: Logarithmic space bound
statement: For each natural number $n$, define its logarithmic space bound to be $ loor{\log_2 n}+1$, where $ loor{\log_2 n}$ is the integer part of the base-$2$ logarithm (and equals $0$ when $n=0$).
